A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with readable text, equations, tables, figures, and complete Appendices A and B. Pages 2–14 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance; differences are confined to page 1.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original dataset-distillation experiments on SVHN, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet subsets, including robustness evaluations, ablations, and parameter analysis.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Section 4, Tables 1–5, and the main-text and appendix visualizations.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithms 1–2 retain identical clustering, CVaR objectives, and synthetic-dataset optimization procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same SVHN, CIFAR-10, ImageNet-10, and additional ImageNet subsets, with identical subgroup, image-corruption, and cross-architecture scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment, including Random, DSA, DM, KIP, IDC, and GLaD in Table 1 and the retained comparator subsets in Tables 2–5.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.8 retain the same preprocessing, IPC settings, model architectures, batch size, clustering settings, CVaR ratio, metrics, and evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The robustness tests, cross-architecture analysis, CVaR-component ablation, parameter sensitivity analysis, and synthesized-sample visualizations are identical, including Appendix B.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains the same five-run averaging statement and uncertainty reporting. Neither version adds or removes seed information, statistical tests, or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–5, plotted results, qualitative visualizations, and reported findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Assumptions 3.1–3.2, Proposition 3.3, DRO arguments, and theoretical details and proof in Appendix A are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about clustering-based robust dataset distillation, theoretical justification, and improved generalization across subgroups.

C2.justification: The explanations of subgroup coverage, robustness, synthesized-sample distributions, and CVaR sensitivity are unchanged. Section 3.1 also retains the same exclusion of training-procedure convergence guarantees from the analysis.

D1.justification: v2 adds a clickable 'Source Code' link to a GitHub repository at the end of the abstract; v1 lacks this access pointer. Implementation descriptions and hyperparameters are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the bibliography, and the paper's novelty positioning relative to dataset distillation and distributionally robust optimization are identical.

P1.justification: The abstract gains the words 'Source Code.' and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The remaining prose, terminology, and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8, Tables 1–5, captions, and their placement are unchanged. The new abstract link fits on the existing line without altering the page layout.

improvement.justification: The new source-code pointer makes implementation resources easier to locate, providing a limited improvement in reproducibility documentation. Methods, evidence, theory, and appendices are unchanged. The supplied PDFs alone do not establish the linked repository's completeness or usability.
